[b]Karal Historical Registries from Archaic Period.[/b]
Between 2500 - 1700 BCE.
Among the first registers of a blood moon in history.
[b]Inscription found in a temple walls, the date is from ~2370[/b]
[i]so  on the  night of 55th day of the 7th year of apah(lord, monarch) Tulkama Zi'a(moon) dressed in red, the Kélpans( sacerdots) offered on the top of the Chik'ot(temple) a offering blood to appease Zi'a, per order of Tulkama, but who is him to be against the will of the great ones(gods)?[/i]
[b] Amphitheater inscriptions or registries [/b]
[b]2420BCE[/b]
Only registry from XXIV century BCE of Chimor history, some call this the Obscure century.
[i] So let this day be marked, the 80th cycle of Katai'i(80 years), me Amawut( master-builder?) Chollish raise this great building, blessed by Zi'a and Katai'i consecrated by kélpan Llunpat.
[b]2377BCE[/b]
The new Apah , Tulkama, on the second day of his reign, he demanded 12 atoks bought from west to be thrown at the  búmas(puma), if they won, they would be set free, but they did not survived, so their flesh feed  up the creatures.
As Zi'a emerged on the skies, the apah ordered the Kélpan to entertain him and his family with notes of charangos(guitars) and pikuyos(flute) and kirkis(drums) on the background, they played the instruments until Katai'i(Chatay, Ardagan) light soon took over Zi'a.
2376BCE.
Apah Tulkama ordered this night taht the amphiteater shall havea  new presentation of masks of jade, a total of 12 men and one with a golden mask representing the first Apah, Yambataapah(this means literally ruler of stars, lack of official registries, most likely a legendary ruler he is) and the foundation of Karal, each masked was a amawut choosen to cut stone and shape the buildings of Karal.
[b]2370 BCE[/b]
So on the 189th day of apah Iampon, soon after a victory against a invasion of the atoks, a man called Warak challenged the apah, instead of being executed, the kuraka Ñisha proposed a duel of the warrior against pumas on the amphiteater until death, so it was done, put in a cage on the center, Warak was drugged with medicinal herbs and given nothing but a club, the first puma was killed as soon his club landed on it heat and broke it skull, soon the second came, his ribs destroyed by the impact, and this until the 5th, when Warak already  shown exhaustion and losing blood, on the 6th he was already terribily injured and almost died, when the 7th puma was put in the cage, Warak finally died with his chest being pierced by the creature's fangs, the apah praised Ñisha for her idea as great, and was entertaining.
[b]2368BCE[/b]
On the  122th day of the 2nd day of Apah Iampon rule, a mysterious man by the name of  Chullkot came from south and offered the apah a great presentation in the amphiteater taht night, curious, Iampon accepted, and on the night, as soon he entered and placed himself on center of the amphiteater, center of attention from all those encircling him, the illumination soon faded, and the man dropped something, and soon a show of colors appeared, thousands of fireflies in spiral flying, and the man controlled them with leaves, the apah praised the man and tried to give him a land in Karal, but he refused to do such and never reuturned again, Iampon ordered the man to be found, but Chullkot was never seen again.
[b][/b]
[b] 2365 BCE[/b]
So on the 22nd day of the 5th year of Iampon, the kélpan Eb'a proposed a dance with the apah, she was a simple woman with great abilities to understand what the gods said, the dance had  kirkis on background being played, while the apah received whisperers of the gods wills and prophecies.
 
[/i]
[b]Codices of Karal[/b].
Several documents found  including many informations about the ancient city, it people, government , mythology etc...
[b]Katai'i[/b]: The great one who illuminates the day, the one responsible for light, and fire.
[b]Zi'a[/b]: the empress of night and tides, rule the night, mother of stars.
[b]D'ialu:[/b] The god musician who is patron of music and creator of instruments.
[b]Ulmu:[/b]Goddess of the woman and birth, mother of all humanity.

[b]Apah[/b]: A man choosen by deities to represent them on world and rule everything and everyone, they are choosen by singnals recognized by the kélpans.
[b]Kélpan[/b]: those blessed by the deities to understand the god's languages and singnals and act as their voice on the mortal realm.
[b]Kasfar:[/b] those commoners who  are nor bearers of the mandate nor the bless of deities are kasfar, however they may have a mandate to be apah some day.
[b]Dwa'i:[/b]The amphiteater where the kélpan and Apah reunite every night for entertainment.
.
.
.
more will have soon.
